projectTitle: Sony A7R III Studio & Photometric Camera System

screens.title: Station 1: Unified Capture Studio (Live View + Settings + Rig)
features: Interactive shutter, aperture, ISO, and white balance dials with live HUD sync
Togglable 9-LED radial light rig with ALL ON/ALL OFF and dimmer
Live camera overlay controls (Grid, Zebra Clipping, Focus Peaking, Freeze Frame)
Single-click autofocus pulse and shutter flash with session filmstrip appending

screens.title: Station 2: Photometric Multi-Light Batch Sequencer
features: Interactive 9-step sequence execution engine (Top Dome + 8 radial spots)
Real-time countdown and stepped progress bar (1/9 to 9/9)
Automated completed batch prepending with direct PBR pipeline shortcut
Dry run hardware validation mode

screens.title: Station 3: Color Science & ColorChecker Calibration
features: 24 clickable X-Rite ColorChecker swatches with CIE2000 Delta-E inspector
Interactive canvas 90° rotation and horizontal flip transforms
Automated SAM grid lock simulation (99.8% confidence)
Calculated 3x3 CCM matrix output and ICC profile exporter

screens.title: Station 4: PBR Texture Synthesis & Normal Map Lab
features: Draggable 3D virtual light probe sphere with live specular highlight tracking
Synchronized 2x2 quad material viewport (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Height)
4K / 8K master resolution selectors and material classification presets
glTF 2.0 material archive package exporter

screens.title: Station 5: Asset Gallery & High-Res Inspection Lightbox
features: Mouse-tracking 100% 1:1 pixel loupe inspector over 61MP RAW imagery
Photometric light selector toolbar (TOP + 8 directional spots)
Meilisearch live search bar and filter controls
Full EXIF hardware telemetry readout and RAW+TIFF batch download
